articles.title: ‘RSS Vs Congress Govt’: Karnataka Cabinet Clears Bill To Curb Events At Public Spaces
articles.description: The Karnataka Cabinet has cleared a bill making prior government permission mandatory for gatherings and activities on government-owned public properties. The proposed law will cover schools, colleges, playgrounds, parks, roads and waterbodies, and is expected to directly impact RSS programmes held on public grounds. The bill seeks to replace a 2025 Home Department order that required permission for gatherings of more than 10 people but was stayed by the Karnataka High Court. The government says the law will apply to all organisations and provide rules for the use of public property. Minister Santosh Lad rejected allegations that the move targets the RSS. The BJP, however, accused the Congress government of politically targeting the RSS and BJP. The bill is expected to be introduced during the ongoing Monsoon Session and could trigger another political and legal battle.
